description: Cache hit: second of two identical Sandy Hook striper queries within 15-min TTL window. Phase 5 P-09 fix (commit d76ab25) wires the pre-graph read-path short-circuit — second query replays the cached recommendation event in ~20ms, no LLM calls, no graph run.
Happy path: striper recommendation at Barnegat Inlet (pinned 2026-05-02 from Phase 3)
Out-of-scope: 'trout in Colorado' triggers planner non_nj_geo reject and graceful SSE error event
Partial conditions arrive via partial_conditions SSE event before the final recommendation (Manasquan Inlet fluke query)
